rawFindings.title: Incorrect argument usage in watchPatterns call disables filtering by watched flag
rawFindings.explanation: The watchPatterns function expects an array of pattern objects, but it previously received such objects and filtered those with watched set to true. The change filters the patterns first and then passes only the pattern strings, which breaks the filtering logic inside watchPatterns that relies on patternObject.watched. The fix is to ensure watchPatterns receives pattern objects having watched true.
rawFindings.suggestion: Change the call from watchPatterns(watchedPatterns, chokidarWatcher) back to watchPatterns(patterns, chokidarWatcher) or adjust watchPatterns to accept pattern strings instead of objects.

rawFindings.title: Changed createIgnore signature requires update of call sites to new parameters
rawFindings.explanation: The createIgnore function is changed to accept both watchedPatterns and excludes arrays, but the call site previously passed only excludes. Passing watchedPatterns and excludes is correct, but all call sites need to be reviewed and updated to pass the two parameters accordingly to prevent runtime errors and ensure ignore works properly.
rawFindings.suggestion: Ensure all createIgnore function calls are updated to pass both watchedPatterns and excludes arrays as arguments.
